text: Thrilled to be awarded the NDSEG Fellowship, 3 years of full PhD funding to keep building cool neurotech!
Our paper Optimizing Cross-Modal Matching for Multimodal Motor Rehab is a Best Student Paper finalist at ICORR 2025! Catch me on the podium at RehabWeek in Chicago this May.
Honored to be nominated for the Harvard SEAS Prize Fellowship, 6 years of tuition and 2 years of stipend to support my PhD journey.
Gave a sneak peek of my multimodal-feedback based motor rehabilitation work at BMES 2024 in Baltimore.
Wrapped up an exciting summer at Harvard’s BIONICs Lab, diving into the edges (and limits) of peripheral neural interfaces in medicine.
Presented my pneumatactor-based soft haptic interfaces at IEEE Haptics Symposium 2024 in sunny Long Beach!
